offering_description.value: Provides in-home personal care, home health and hospice services to elderly and disabled adults. Caregivers visit patients' homes, and government programs and health plans pay for the care.

primary_services.value: personal care; home health nursing; hospice care; care coordination

items.detail: state Medicaid agencies and waiver programs
Medicare Advantage plans and managed care organizations
in-home care billed to Medicaid and managed care payers
Medicare and Medicaid payments for home health and hospice
delivers in-home care through caregivers, sold to government payers and health plans

geography_served.detail: many US states, including Illinois and Texas

specialization.detail: personal care, home health and hospice services sharing payers and caregivers

items.detail: contracts with state agencies and health plans
local branch offices serving patients in their homes

regulatory_exposure.detail: state licensing and Medicare/Medicaid certification for home health and hospice, overseen by CMS and state health agencies
